Interface Scheduler

@NonExtendable public interface Scheduler
Runs code on the thread that owns what it touches (D35), on Paper and Folia alike: on Paper every thread below is the main thread, on Folia it is the global region, the region owning a location, or the region owning an entity. Get one with MachineEngine.scheduler(plugin): its tasks belong to that plugin and stop when it is disabled.

Delays and periods are in ticks; anything below 1 counts as 1. Once the server is stopping, nothing is scheduled (such a task would never run): run does nothing, runLater and runTimer return a cancelled task, and the entity variants return false or null.

    • run

      boolean run(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Entity entity, @NotNull @NotNull Runnable task, @Nullable @Nullable Runnable retired)
      Runs task on the next tick of the region owning entity. If the entity is removed first, retired runs instead (on the entity's last thread, or at once).
      Returns:
      false, and nothing is scheduled, if the entity is no longer valid (a player who left)
